side_a: Do NOT deduct when the answer only contrasts the general properties of HashMap and Collections.singletonMap (mutable vs immutable, overhead, 'would throw on modification') without attributing any need for mutation to messageParams or to this call site — including answers that go on to recommend passing singletonMap directly because nothing here modifies the map.
